subject: Face
text: Face enemies outside the castle can be killed in one hit with a full Will bar Morning Star attack.

evidence.quote:
There will be some Face enemies; if you have a full Will bar, the Morning
  Star will kill them in one hit.

subject: Chimera
text: Chimera is invulnerable to Lit and must be damaged rapidly with Fire.

evidence.quote:
Chimera is invulnerable to Lit; Fire must be used.
--- Cast Fire rapidly.

subject: Chimera
text: Chimera dives dealing about 45 damage when reaching the center of the screen, so cast Cure if HP is below 50.

evidence.quote:
Specifically, each time he reaches the center of the screen, he may dive.
--- This deals about 45 damage; if your HP is below 50, cast Cure.

subject: Girl
text: The Girl heals you when you use her ASK command.

evidence.quote: The Girl can heal you with her ASK command.  Do this often.

subject: Wizard
text: Wizards inflict Stone with magic or Moogle on contact, and can only be defeated with about 10 Morning Star hits.

evidence.quote:
Wizards can be killed with about 10 Morning Star hits, but are otherwise
    invincible.
--- Wizards inflict Stone with their magic, or Moogle from touching them.

subject: Dark Knight
text: Dark Knights can be killed with a single Fire cast when struck from the side or back.

evidence.quote:
Dark Knights can be killed with a single Fire cast, but have to be hit
    from the side or the back.

subject: Flashing
text: While flashing from damage, you cannot press a button and cannot enter stairs.

evidence.quote:
While you are flashing from damage, you cannot press a button, and you
  cannot enter Stairs.

subject: Werewolf Room
text: If any treasure chests in the Werewolf room are destroyed or moved, the stairs will disappear.

evidence.quote:
The way this Werewolf room works is, if any of the treasure chests are
  destroyed or moved, the stairs wil disappear.

subject: Ice Room
text: Solving the Ice room puzzle requires turning Dark Knights into snowmen and pushing one onto each of the two buttons.

evidence.quote:
The goal is to push a snowman onto each of the two buttons.
- Only the Dark Knights can be turned into snowmen.

subject: Dark Lord
text: Dark Lord deals about 55 damage and can only be harmed by the Lit spell.

evidence.quote:
Dark Lord deals about 55 damage.  Cast cure if you're below 60 HP.
- Dark Lord can only be hurt by Lit.

subject: Dark Lord
text: You can get Dark Lord stuck in the upper corner of the arena, walk into him with Lit equipped to turn him away, and blast his backside with Lit.

evidence.quote:
Equip Cure and run off to the upper right or upper left corner of the arena.
- If Dark Lord is 1/2 tile to the side (rather than exactly aligned with you),
  he may get stuck rather than actually running into you....Wait for your Will meter to fill.
- Equip Lit and walk down into Dark Lord.
--- This will make him turn away from you.
- Cast Lit.
--- This should hit his backside.

subject: Ish Weapon Shop
text: Flame Armor is purchased at the Weapon Shop in Ish.

evidence.quote:
Enter the Weapon Shop.
--- Buy Flame Armor

subject: Chocobot
text: After sleeping at the Inn in Ish, go west through the door and speak to Chocobot outside town to recruit him.

evidence.quote:
Go W, Door
- Sleep at the Inn.
Go W, Door
- You now have the Chocobot.

Go E, S, S (Exits Ish)
- Talk to your Chocobot to recruit him.

subject: Lorim Snowfields Enemies
text: Wolves and Snowmen in Lorim Snowfields die in one Fire cast, while Walruses die to Fire with a mostly full Will meter.

evidence.quote:
Wolves and Snowmen die in one Fire cast, while Walruses will die if the
    Will meter is mostly full.

subject: Eye
text: Eyes in the Ice Cavern are invincible and inflict Stone status.

evidence.quote: Eyes are invincible, and they inflict Stone.

subject: Poto
text: Potos die in 1 Fire cast and drop X-Ethers.

evidence.quote: Potos (the white jumping things) die in 1 Fire cast, and drop X-Ethers.

subject: Duck Knight
text: Duck Knights die to 2 Fire casts or a Fire cast with a nearly full Will bar.

evidence.quote: Duck Knights die in 2 Fire casts or with a nearly full Will bar.

subject: Ice
text: Ice tiles behave like one-way conveyor belts rather than standard slippery surfaces.

evidence.quote:
Something to understand: ice in this game is actually a 1-way conveyor belt,
  rather than behaving like you'd expect ice to behave.

subject: Recovery Pond
text: A recovery pond is located behind a Mattockable northern wall after climbing the stairs with two horizontal lines of ice.

evidence.quote:
You should emerge from the stairs on a screen with two horizontal lines of
  ice, and an obviously Mattockable wall to the north.
- There is a recovery pond to the north, if you need it.

subject: Kary
text: Kary is immune to Nuke, and only her head is vulnerable to attacks.

evidence.quote:
If for some reason you got Nuke before coming here, she is immune to Nuke.
- Only her head is vulnerable.

subject: Kary
text: To defeat Kary, hit her head with Fire, then Lit, then Lit again while dodging her icicles and charges.

evidence.quote:
You will hit her with Fire, then Lit, then Lit again

- Dodge her initial icicles.

As she crosses back in front of you, hit her head with Lit.
--- Retreat to the top again immediately!

- Aim to the right, and start shooting Lit right as her left hands pass you.
--- With proper timing, you'll hit her head as she stars moving upward again.
- Walk downward, dodge her charge and icicles, and repeat the pattern.

subject: Kary
text: Defeating Kary awards the Ice Sword.

evidence.quote: Win Ice Sword.

subject: Cibba
text: Talking to Cibba in Lorim gives you the Bone Key.

evidence.quote: Talk to Cibba and you'll get the Bone Key.

subject: Elixir Island
text: Defeating all the fire-breathing sea horses with Lit on Elixir Island makes an Elixir appear.

evidence.quote: Your goal is to use Lit to kill all the (fire breathing) sea horses....Collect the Elixir that appears.

subject: Ammonite Coast Enemies
text: Manta Rays inflict Poison, and Griffin Hands inflict Moogle status which can be removed by mounting the Chocobo.

evidence.quote:
Manta Rays inflict Poison.
--- Griffin Hands inflict Moogle.  You can un-moogle yourself by hopping on
    the Chocobo.

subject: Floatrocks
text: Floatrocks in the Floatrock Fields can be destroyed using the Morning Star.

evidence.quote:
This takes you to the Floatrock Fields.
- Floatrocks can be destroyed by the Morning Star.

subject: Kraken's Cave
text: Kraken's Cave in the Floatrock Fields is opened by equipping the Bone Key.

evidence.quote: Enter this cave by equipping the Bone Key.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken's tentacles are invulnerable; cast full Will meter Fire spells at his head from the second bridge tile from the right.

evidence.quote:
Cast one Fire as soon as you enter the room, then run to the second Bridge
  tile from the right.
--- This square is as close as you can be to the Kraken's right tentacle
    without taking damage.
- Only cast when your Will meter is full.
- The Tentacles are not vulnerable, only his head is.

subject: Earth Elemental
text: Earth Elementals in the Undersea Volcano die in 1 Lit cast and drop X-Ethers.

evidence.quote: Earth Elementals die in 1 Lit cast and drop X-Ethers.

subject: Lava
text: Crossing lava deals about three-quarters of your maximum health in damage.

evidence.quote: Lava will deal about 3/4 of your health in damage.

subject: Iflyte
text: Iflyte is vulnerable to Lit on his head, including when he bounces around in ball form.

evidence.quote:
Use Lit.
- Like Metal Crab, only his head is vulnerable.
- His head is still vulnerable when he's in ball form; aim for the center and
  lead your target as he bounces around.

subject: Iflyte
text: Defeating Iflyte rewards the Rusty Sword.

evidence.quote: Win the Rusty Sword.

subject: Lich
text: Lich deals about 100 damage per hit and should be countered with fully charged Lit spells following Megapede's movement pattern.

evidence.quote:
This boss deals about 100 damage per hit.
- Use fully charged Lit spells.

- Lich follows the same movement pattern as Megapede.

subject: Lich
text: Defeating Lich rewards the Nuke spell.

evidence.quote: Win the Nuke spell.
